title: Self Employed Tailor
description: A Self Employed Tailor is a skilled artisan capable of drafting, cutting, stitching, and finishing various garments independently or through custom boutique/home-based setup.
awarding_body: Apparel Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)
certifying_bodies: National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET)
proposed_occupation: Self Employed Tailor / Custom Garment Manufacturer / Boutique Owner
progression_pathway: Assistant Tailor (NSQF Level 3) -> Self Employed Tailor (NSQF Level 4) -> Master Tailor / Sample Tailor (NSQF Level 5) -> Apparel Boutique Entrepreneur (NSQF Level 6)

title: Sewing Machine Operator
description: Performs industrial sewing operations for commercial garment manufacturing, specialized alterations, and precision stitching.
proposed_occupation: Industrial Sewing Machine Operator / Garment Factory Technician
progression_pathway: Sewing Machine Operator (NSQF Level 3) -> Senior Machinist (NSQF Level 4) -> Line Supervisor (NSQF Level 5)

title: Field Technician - Wireman & Domestic Electricals
description: Installs, tests, maintains, and repairs domestic wiring, electrical fixtures, distribution panels, and household appliances.
awarding_body: Electronics Sector Skills Council of India (ESSCI)
proposed_occupation: Licensed Wireman / Domestic Electrician / Service Technician
progression_pathway: Helper Electrician (NSQF Level 3) -> Domestic Electrician (NSQF Level 4) -> Industrial Electrical Supervisor (NSQF Level 5)

title: Suryamitra Solar PV Installer
description: Installs, tests, and commissions rooftop and ground-mounted solar photovoltaic systems, solar water pumps, and inverter units.
proposed_occupation: Solar PV Installer / Green Energy Entrepreneur
progression_pathway: Solar Assembly Assistant (NSQF Level 3) -> Suryamitra Solar Installer (NSQF Level 4) -> Solar Project Engineer (NSQF Level 6)

title: Micro Irrigation Technician
description: Installs and maintains drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for agricultural farms, nurseries, and horticulture projects.
proposed_occupation: Micro Irrigation Specialist / Agri-Inputs Retailer / Farm Manager
progression_pathway: Farm Helper (NSQF Level 2) -> Micro Irrigation Technician (NSQF Level 4) -> Precision Agriculture Supervisor (NSQF Level 5)
